programs.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programs.desc: Hosts Tianran and Hannah head to Hangzhou, the birthplace of green tea. While gliding across the city's famous West Lake, the two sip Longjing tea and dive into Hangzhou cuisine. Next, they trade the lake for the forest, hiking ancient mountain paths to Jingshan Temple, where they experience the quiet harmony between nature and humanity—the essence of Eastern living.

programs.title: Lancang-Mekong: The River That Flows South Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary follows 24 families along the Lancang-Mekong River—their lives, their connections, and the quiet ways they remain independent yet bound to one another. What emerges is a portrait of shared wisdom, shaped by the river and passed down for generations.
